notes.title: Major Update with MORE CONTENT
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,
A [b]Major update[/b] for game is coming soon (before[b] 5 April[/b] i think). The game will make more sense afterwards.

I'm also going to reduce price of game to [b]1.99$[/b], as i think [b]1.99$[/b] is reasonable price for a small game like this.
